title: Creamy Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: This creamy tagine is a twist on the traditional Moroccan dish, made with tender chicken, exotic spices, and a rich creamy sauce.

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.notes: feta or goat cheese work well

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the bottom of a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
